description: This file contains functions for resolving CSS stylesheet imports, inlining styles and background images, and managing stylesheet elements within the document head, specifically for the Notesnook project.

methods.name: resolveImports
methods.description: Resolves and inlines @import rules within stylesheets.

methods.name: downloadStylesheet
methods.description: Fetches a stylesheet from a URL and returns it as a style element.

methods.name: skipStyleSheet
methods.description: Determines if a stylesheet should be skipped, especially for print media.

methods.name: isStylesheetForPrint
methods.description: Checks if a stylesheet is intended for print media.

methods.name: addStylesToHead
methods.description: Main function to add styles to the document head, resolving imports and inlining images.

methods.name: rulesToStyleNode
methods.description: Converts a list of CSS rules into a style DOM node.

methods.name: inlineBackgroundImages
methods.description: Inlines background images within CSS rules.

methods.name: processStyleRule
methods.description: Processes individual style rules to inline images.
